annotations.title: The most searched product queries of a country (daily ranking)

description: The 30 most searched product queries of one delivery country, recomputed once a day by the worker from three free sources: Google Trends' public daily-trends RSS of the country (about ten queries of the last day with an approximate traffic; it has no public shopping filter, so a trend stays only when it matches our products), forDeal's own search log of the country and the human clicks to a shop of the last 7 days. Each entry is `query` (the most frequent spelling), `rank`, `score` = 15 × log2(1 + trends traffic / 100) + 25 × log2(1 + searches) + 20 × log2(1 + clicks), `parts`, `raw` (traffic, searches, clicks, matched products), `sources` and `product`: the product that stands for the query, a summary like search_products (only products with a photo and offers from two or more shops; one product once). `group` is the home rows' group name, `date` the day of the ranking; `generated_at` null before the first run. Next: get_product with the product slug for the full comparison.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the ranking, e.g. "CZ". Default: the first country the price hunter serves.

deliver_to_country.description: Same as `country` (the other tools' name for it); `country` wins when both are given.

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for human-readable strings, e.g. "en", "cs", "sk". Defaults to the country's default locale.
